MA-LIO numerical core
Source: https://github.com/minwoo0611/MA-LIO
Upstream commit: 8e4645f3c77e273cce0f098d270c3068570181c0

The retained computational sources implement the authors' IMU initialization,
B-spline point deskew, IESKF, planar residual/uncertainty and incremental k-d tree.
MA-SLAM is a C++ ROS2 integration; it is not a Python estimator rewrite.
See LICENSE and individual file headers for upstream and component notices.

Files copied without numerical changes:
BsplineSE3.cpp/.h, quat_ops.h, Exp_mat.h, so3_math.h, associate_uct.hpp,
ikd-Tree and IKFoM support headers. associate_uct.hpp uses portable Eigen includes.
BsplineSE3.cpp explicitly includes <cassert> for its existing assertions.

Retained corrections from the previously validated native integration:
- Initialize last IMU end time and last acceleration.
- Include the first scan point in the deskew loop.
- Drop points outside spline support and wait for full support before map seeding.
- Permute all covariance blocks, including cross terms, with physical LiDAR IDs.
- Resize correspondence arrays before writes; require three effective planes.
- Calculate measurement covariance with fixed as well as estimated extrinsics.
- Guard constant covariance ranges against division by zero.
- Read the updated KF state before refreshing extrinsics and inserting map points.
- Keep measured intensity independently of overloaded internal point intensity.
- Export center-LiDAR covariance with attitude, lever-arm and cross terms.
- Reject over 100000 registration points instead of overrunning upstream arrays.
- Keep configurable neighbor/plane-residual gates at 1.0m / 0.2m by default.
- Performance only (identical outputs): reuse the B-spline pose for consecutive deskew
  points with an equal timestamp, and drop per-call omp_get_wtime() profiling in
  BsplineSE3::get_pose (total_time was never read).

New integration-only changes:
- Replace ROS1 message/time dependencies with measurementTypes.hpp records.
- Select the original 2- or 3-LiDAR manifold with MA_SLAM_LIDAR_COUNT at compile time.
- Move the prior adapter to src/imuPreintegration.cpp and original scan matching
  into src/lidarOdometry.inc. Input/output are typed C++ records, without pybind.
- The estimator retains upstream process-global state; use one instance per process.
- ROS2 nodes own subscriptions, timestamp conversion, synchronization and publishing.

No source generation, Python runtime, ROS1 compatibility headers, playback utility,
figures, or custom sensor-message package is needed by this core.
